title: Is jazz extinct; Natty Dominique and color
summary: Rose says jazz has not survived. He tells of a friend who lost respect for Natty Dominique on learning he was black, and argues color is irrelevant to the music.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
